doc_summary: `native_compute_fov(partial, camera, degrees)` receives the computed world FOV after settings, ordinary FOV effects and zoom, before projection/Nausea. `camera` is its world position and `partial` the interpolation fraction. Mods can narrow or widen the angle; only finite values in 1..=179 degrees are accepted, otherwise the original computed angle is used. It runs for world rendering and near-plane overlays, not just once per frame. Hand/HUD FOV and the title panorama keep their existing paths. Bundles need "hooks": @API:compute_fov@.
